transcript: There's not really a whole lot I can add to this, but I just want a society of just love. Everyone gets along really well. Everyone helps each other. No hate. No violence. Just everyone helping and getting along. That's all I could really ask for. Everyone's always willing to give a hand when things get hard. It's a really happy society is what I want, nothing special.
